messages.subject: Re: [aroma.affymetrix] Re: ExonRmaPlm and mergeGroups=TRUE/FALSE? (Was: Re: aroma.affymetrix v0.4.1 released)
parts:
Hi,

yes, Ken added this. From the code of ExonRmaPlm(), see
unclass(ExonRmaPlm), it looks like if mergeGroups=TRUE then the tag
"merged" is added, otherwise no tag is added. So, if you your
previous analysis was with mergeGroups=FALSE, nothing should change,
but if it was with mergeGroups=TRUE add tag "merged" to that PLM
output set directory, e.g. plmData/MyData,RMA,merged/ and
aroma.affymetrix (v1.7.4) should find it next time.

BTW, like for most methods, you can argument 'verbose=<negative
number>' to see details on what is going on, e.g. fit(plm,
verbose=-4).

Hope this helps

Henrik
